headline: OpenAI and Upwork report task rebundling in AI-related freelance work
summary: A Nov 10 OpenAI/Upwork report compares sampled ChatGPT activity with Upwork job postings and examines how AI-related projects combine tasks. Across 63 matched work categories, the report describes a non-uniform relationship between ChatGPT-use intensity and changes in marketplace share. It reports that task diversity in AI-related postings rose from an effective 14.6 to 21.2 clusters between early 2023 and late 2025; adjusted fixed-price budgets were about 52% higher and first-90-day hours about 41% higher for hired hourly contracts, while adjusted hourly rates were about 1.5% higher. These are descriptive, first-party marketplace associations, not causal effects or evidence of aggregate employment change.
